semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow exact or context-complete visual-obligation phrases create hard lighting duties. Bare mood, genre, fixture, modifier, color-quality metric, and BM25F or embedding-only hits remain advisory.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: A selected lighting cluster must remain coherent across lighting, direction, source type, relative intensity, light shape, color, and one grading or film finish. A postprocess look cannot replace a scene-light component.
semantic_policy.claim_boundary: Pixels may support visible direction, shadow-edge transfer, form modeling, source-owned color zones, highlight morphology, tonal distribution, and optical response. They do not establish fixture brand, wattage, exact lux, exact ratio, CCT, CRI, TLCI, SSI, SPD, lens model, film stock, or lab process.
semantic_policy.reference_boundary: A supplied portrait may guide only visible adult appearance, face and hair continuity, and requested framing. It never activates lighting meaning, personality, identity, protected traits, occupation, relationship, ethnicity, or nationality.
semantic_policy.judgment_boundary: Dictionary, index, routing, prompt, generation delivery, rendered pixels, and requesting-user judgment are separate evidence layers. Every hard gate must pass in the same frame; partial visibility is failure.

review_scope: Former prose-only policy and representation declarations preserved without granting runtime authority.
